intro.narration: [excited] Square root of two thousand two hundred thirty-two — with no calculator? [pause] Watch this.

steps.narration: [curious] No long division, no guessing. [pause] Two decimal places, in your head.
[confident] Here is the rule. Take the nearest whole square, then add the gap divided by twice its root.
[thoughtful] Forty-seven squared is twenty-two oh nine. [pause] So the gap is twenty-three.
steps.instruction: Find the anchor and the gap

steps.narration: [excited] Twenty-three over ninety-four? Zero point two four. [pause] Forty-seven point two four.
[warm] Anchor on forty instead and you get forty-seven point nine. [pause] Use the nearest square.
steps.instruction: A far square loses the decimals
